defects.description: Updates advance the generation without evicting cached projections of obsolete states.

trigger.input: timeout 20s node --input-type=module -e 'import {ProjectionStore} from "./src/store.js"; const s=new ProjectionStore(x=>x); for(let i=0;i<1000;i++){s.update("a",i);s.page();} console.log(s.retainedPages);'

defects.why_missed: A test of updated page contents passes on both variants; only retained state after repeated update/read cycles distinguishes them. S9(a): repeated multi-step sequence.

defects.description: Once the index reaches 1000 keys, each subsequent batch re-evaluates every retained key, making work quadratic.

trigger.input: timeout 20s node --input-type=module -e 'import {mergeBatches} from "./src/store.js"; let calls=0; const rows=mergeBatches(Array.from({length:2000},(_,id)=>[{id}]),x=>{calls++;return x.id;}); console.log(rows.length,calls);'

defects.why_missed: Result equality and counters below the index threshold are identical across variants. S9(b): callback work diverges only after at least 1000 distinct items; the probe accumulates work over 2000 items.
